categories.main_business_segments: Hangzhou Sunrise Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the energy IoT equipment sector, focusing on the research, production, sales, and services of smart electric meters, smart water meters, smart electrical products, energy cloud edge routers, and IoT sensors. The company also provides comprehensive energy solutions integrating IoT terminals with big data and cloud computing, serving public energy sectors including water, electricity, gas, and heat.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages embedded AI, IoT, big data, cloud computing, and communication technologies such as 4G/NB for smart metering and energy management. It has developed intelligent measurement and acquisition systems, smart power terminals, and smart flow meters with modular, multifunctional designs. Manufacturing is supported by an advanced intelligent manufacturing system integrating MES, ERP, CRM, PLM, and WMS, recognized as a leading smart factory in China.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and regional power grid companies such as State Grid and Southern Power Grid, as well as industrial, commercial, and residential users. The company serves sectors like public utilities, industrial parks, hospitals, schools, petrochemical, and rail transit. Its products and solutions are also marketed internationally, including in Germany, Czech Republic, and Belt and Road countries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant presence in the Yangtze River Delta region. It has subsidiaries and operations in Zhejiang, Shanghai, and Hong Kong, and international subsidiaries in the Czech Republic. Overseas sales accounted for about 10% of revenue, with growing exports to Europe and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hangzhou Sunrise Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy IoT supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of smart metering devices and IoT terminals. It also provides integrated energy management solutions and services, positioning itself as a comprehensive energy IoT solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in embedded AI for smart energy measurement, virtual power plant energy control, and energy consumption optimization systems. It invests heavily in innovation around public energy metering, AMI systems, smart flow measurement, smart charging, power quality management, and electrical safety monitoring. The strategy includes expanding IoT terminal integration with big data and cloud computing to enhance energy efficiency and digital transformation aligned with carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of smart metering devices and IoT products. The company also earns from providing energy IoT platform services, technical services, and leasing activities. Government subsidies and investment income contribute to other revenue streams. The sales model is predominantly direct sales to power grid companies and industrial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the leading domestic high-tech enterprises in the energy metering and IoT industry in China, with strong technical influence and growth potential. It competes with other domestic and international smart meter manufacturers and energy IoT solution providers, leveraging its technological innovation, intelligent manufacturing, and comprehensive service capabilities to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.03 billion, a 14.54% increase from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 664.66 million, up 9.45%. Total assets reached RMB 4.81 billion, growing 9.11%. The company maintains a healthy cash flow and continues to increase R&D investment, reflecting a stable growth trajectory and expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hangzhou Sunrise Technology emphasizes precise measurement, intelligent energy management, and integration of IoT with cloud and big data technologies. Its products offer multifunctional smart metering with advanced communication capabilities, supporting energy efficiency, demand response, and grid stability. The company’s intelligent manufacturing and quality management systems ensure high product reliability, while its technical marketing and after-sales services provide strong customer support, differentiating it in the energy IoT market.
